headline: Ramayana Day 18: ₹35.60 Cr India nett
lede: Ramayana closed Day 18 on Monday, 23 November 2026 at ₹35.60 Cr India nett and ₹42.50 Cr India gross, +28.8% from Day 17's ₹27.65 Cr. That day played on 16,277 shows at 37.9% occupancy. This is the closed day on the desk, not a live estimate.
body:
Through Day 19 the desk has Ramayana at ₹968.2 Cr India nett, ₹1,141.7 Cr India gross, ₹568.0 Cr overseas and ₹1,709.7 Cr worldwide. Adding the day-wise nett rows gives ₹955.45 Cr, which is a different series from that lifetime nett, so the two are not combined. Behind it on the daily chart, O.M Operation Mole at ₹6.20 Cr and Aakasamlo Oka Tara at ₹3.20 Cr. This day's overseas figure is not in, so it is not used to move the worldwide total.

Trade coverage is still led by Ramayana. News18 is citing about ₹1,700.0 Cr, India Today is citing about ₹1,700.0 Cr, The Times of India is citing about ₹955.0 Cr. The desk keeps ₹968.2 Cr India nett and ₹1,709.7 Cr worldwide, and does not blend those reports into its own total. No producer-certified total is included.
